nodes.description: Robotars constructor: initializes ERC1155 with URI_BASE and calls _initializeEIP712(NAME)
withdraw(): onlyOwner, forwards entire contract balance to msg.sender via low level call
mintPayable(uint256): public payable mint gated by saleActive and msg.value >= price*count
mintPresale(uint256): mint gated by presaleActive and per-address whitelist reservation
mint(address,uint256): onlyOwner mint of a batch to an arbitrary address
_batchMint(address,uint256): private loop assigning random token ids and calling super._mintBatch
randomToken(): pseudo random id selection using nonce, msg.sender, block.difficulty and block.timestamp
setPrice(uint256): onlyOwner update of the mint price
setSalePreSale(bool,bool): onlyOwner toggling of saleActive and presaleActive
editPresale(address[],uint256[]): onlyOwner bulk write of the presale whitelist
transferBatch(address,address,uint256[],uint256[]): wrapper around ERC1155 safeBatchTransferFrom
executeMetaTransaction(...): payable meta transaction that verifies a signature and self-calls with appended userAddress
setBaseUri(string): onlyOwner update of the metadata base URI
_doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck: calls onERC1155Received on the receiver contract
ERC1155._mintBatch: loops over ids/amounts and credits balances
price: mint price in wei, mutable by onlyOwner setPrice
currentID: counter of tokens already minted, drives MAX_TOTAL_SUPPLY - currentID
nonce: incrementing counter mixed into the token randomness
indices: fixed array used by the pseudo random swap-and-pop selection
presaleWhitelist: mapping address => reserved mint amount
presaleActive: enables mintPresale
saleActive: enables mintPayable
URI_BASE: metadata prefix concatenated with token id in _getUri
nonces: mapping address => meta transaction nonce used for replay protection
_owner: Ownable owner address checked by the onlyOwner modifier
msg.sender: caller address used for gating, whitelist lookup, entropy and transfer destination
block.timestamp: miner influenced value used as entropy in randomToken
msg.sender.call{value: address(this).balance} low level value transfer in withdraw
address(this).call(abi.encodePacked(functionSignature, userAddress)) self call in executeMetaTransaction
price.mul(_customBatchCount) arithmetic check against msg.value in mintPayable
price.mul(_customBatchCount) arithmetic check against msg.value in mintPresale
keccak256(nonce,msg.sender,block.difficulty,block.timestamp) % totalSize weak randomness
unchecked balance subtraction in ERC1155 internal transfer/burn accounting
external call to IERC1155Receiver.onERC1155Received on the receiving contract
totalSize = MAX_TOTAL_SUPPLY - currentID subtraction inside _batchMint/randomToken
_customBatchCount: number of tokens requested by the minter
_to: recipient passed to mint and _batchMint
num: batch size parameter of _batchMint
totalSize: remaining supply local computed as MAX_TOTAL_SUPPLY - currentID
range: loop bound local in _batchMint
ids: memory array of generated token ids in _batchMint
amounts: memory array of amounts in _batchMint
token: token id returned by randomToken and stored in ids
index: pseudo random index derived from the keccak hash
value: swap-and-pop selected index/value from indices
_newPrice: new mint price passed to setPrice
isSale: new value of saleActive
isPreSale: new value of presaleActive
presaleAddresses: addresses whitelisted by editPresale
amount: reserved amounts written by editPresale
from: source address of transferBatch
to: destination address of transferBatch
ids: token ids transferred by transferBatch
amounts: amounts transferred by transferBatch
userAddress: signer address of the meta transaction
functionSignature: calldata executed by the meta transaction self call
sigR: ECDSA signature component
sigS: ECDSA signature component
sigV: ECDSA signature recovery id
metaTx: MetaTransaction struct hashed for signature verification
returnData: bytes returned by the meta transaction self call
_uri: new metadata base URI passed to setBaseUri
reserved: current whitelist reservation of msg.sender in mintPresale

edges.reason: withdraw is guarded by onlyOwner which requires owner() == _msgSender()
_owner state variable is read by onlyOwner before withdraw can execute
withdraw performs msg.sender.call{value: address(this).balance} sending the whole balance
the external value transfer to msg.sender can re-enter withdraw
mint(address,uint256) is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner
setPrice is onlyOwner and can change the mint price arbitrarily
setSalePreSale is onlyOwner and toggles saleActive/presaleActive
editPresale is onlyOwner and can write arbitrary whitelist reservations
setBaseUri is onlyOwner and can repoint the metadata URI
mintPresale is gated by the caller's presaleWhitelist reservation and presaleActive
mintPayable is publicly callable while saleActive
executeMetaTransaction is publicly callable and payable
msg.sender is mixed into the keccak256 entropy of the token id
block.timestamp is used as entropy making the token id predictable and miner influenceable
randomToken depends on block.timestamp and block.difficulty
random token index is keccak256(nonce,msg.sender,block.difficulty,block.timestamp) % totalSize
nonce is a component of the randomness input and is incremented each call
indices array is consulted for the pseudo randomly selected index
value falls back to index when indices[index] is zero
random value incremented by 1 becomes the minted token id
token id is stored into the local ids array
ids array is passed to super._mintBatch
amounts array is passed to super._mintBatch
num parameter drives the mint loop and array allocations
_to is the recipient of the batch mint
_customBatchCount is bounded by and subtracted from the whitelist reservation
_customBatchCount is multiplied by price in the msg.value check of mintPayable
_customBatchCount is multiplied by price in the msg.value check of mintPresale
price state variable is used in price.mul(_customBatchCount)
price state variable is used in price.mul(_customBatchCount)
presaleWhitelist[msg.sender] is read as the reserved amount
reservation is decremented in the whitelist after minting
currentID is subtracted from MAX_TOTAL_SUPPLY
totalSize = MAX_TOTAL_SUPPLY - currentID can underflow if currentID exceeds the supply
the totalSize subtraction is computed inside _batchMint
_batchMint calls super._mintBatch with the generated ids and amounts
mint delegates the actual minting to _batchMint
mintPayable delegates the actual minting to _batchMint
mintPresale delegates the actual minting to _batchMint
acceptance check performs an external call into the receiver contract
ERC1155 receiver hook can re-enter the contract during batch minting
executeMetaTransaction executes address(this).call with user supplied calldata
the self call could re-enter privileged functions such as withdraw
nonces[userAddress] is read and incremented to prevent replay
userAddress selects the nonce and is appended to the executing calldata
functionSignature is appended to the executing calldata
_newPrice overwrites the price state variable
isSale sets saleActive
isPreSale sets presaleActive
presaleAddresses are the keys written into the whitelist mapping
amount values are written into the whitelist mapping
_uri overwrites URI_BASE
constructor passes URI_BASE into the ERC1155 base contract
transferBatch routes into ERC1155 internal balance updates that use unchecked subtraction after a require
presaleActive flag must be true for mintPresale to proceed
saleActive flag must be true for mintPayable to proceed
